depiction.primary_object: magnifying glass framing three vertical bar chart columns
modifiers: three vertical bars of different heights inside the lens
depiction.composition: magnifying glass angled to lower right with bar chart centered in lens

readings.meaning: data analysis, analytics, or inspecting metrics

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the three bars inside the lens can look like an audio equalizer or pause/menu lines.

modifier_semantics.meaning: statistics, metrics, or chart data being examined

examine server load and usage graphs
